title: Receives any number of outbound quantities
goal: uses the remaining parameters to collect an indefinite number of actual parameters into an array.
summary: A shipment may only contain one batch, or it may consist of multiple batches. The function receives each batch quantity and adds the registered quantity.
tasks: completes shippedCount(prior, ...batches), priority is the registered quantity, and the remaining parameters are the new shipment quantity of each batch.
returns the total of all quantities. Returns prior when there are no new batches.

example.note: ...added placed at the end will collect the remaining actual parameters into an array.

hint: Start the accumulator from prior and then traverse batches.
